info.title: TWB AI Translation & Review Platform API
info.summary: The seven calls the TWB platform needs to run a job, plus optional extras.

post.description: Upload a DOCX, UTF-8 TXT, SRT or WebVTT file (up to 20 MB), then create a job with `"source": {"file_id": "<id>"}`. XLIFF, PPTX and others come later (FR1.6). With `?purpose=reference`, upload a file for reviewers to consult instead (PDF, Office, text or image), and list it in the job's `reference_file_ids`.

Segments the source and creates one mt task per target language and a review task for each language in review_langs; MT starts at once. Idempotent on external_ref: repeating the call returns the existing job with 200.

get.summary: Look up a job by external_ref

get.description: Source, current target and provenance per segment, in document order.

schema.title: Response List Segments V1 Jobs  Job Id  Segments Get

get.description: The translated file in the original format (TXT, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, SRT or VTT), or XLIFF 2.1 / TMX with ?format=. Available once MT for the language has finished; segments without a target carry the source text, counted in the X-Untranslated-Segments header.
Every reviewer and partner comment on the job's segments, oldest first (FR5.7).

schema.title: Response List Comments V1 Jobs  Job Id  Comments Get

get.description: Per segment of one target language, the MT or memory text review started from and the text now, with edit distance and status; plus a summary for the job (FR5.5).

post.description: Starts review round n+1 for the given languages of a job whose review is done (FR1.7): a new review task per language, to assign as usual. Segments go back to translated with their current text, so the next reviewer starts from round n's result; every earlier version, flag, comment and time entry stays. Emits job.reopened.
The TWB platform assigns; the service never chooses an assignee (FR1.4).

post.summary: Split a review task into parts
post.description: Divides an unstarted review, translate or SME task into parts by segment range, cut at paragraph boundaries where possible (FR1.8). The task becomes part 1 and keeps its assignee; parts 2..n are new tasks to assign. Reviewers see the whole document and edit their own part; approvals are shared across parts within seconds (FR9).

schema.title: Response Split Task V1 Tasks  Task Id  Split Post

post.description: Short-lived signed link /work/{task_id}?token=… for one user (FR5.10, FR7.2). The link works once: opening it starts an editor session for that task. Only the assignee may get a link, or a language lead (role lead).

get.description: Active review time is the payable quantity (FR6.7). Accepted, edited and flagged count each segment once, by its latest human action; mean edit distance is over approved segments, against the starting point (FR6.3). Words are source words by match band, for platforms that also pay or compare per word.

schema.title: Response List Webhooks V1 Webhooks Get

post.description: Events for jobs created with this API key are POSTed to the URL as JSON, signed in `X-Katong-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` (HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<body>` with the secret returned here, once). Non-2xx answers are retried with backoff for about ten hours.

schema.title: Response List Deliveries V1 Webhooks  Webhook Id  Deliveries Get
Response List Engines V1 Engines Get

post.description: For quick checks, chatbots and engine comparison. Without `engine` the routing table picks one, as for a job; naming an engine bypasses routing and is for staff comparisons only. With a partner_id, the partner's and TWB-wide termbases and memories adapt the request unless adaptive is false. Nothing is stored.

schema.title: Response List Tms V1 Tms Get

post.description: Units in the memory's language pair are added; duplicates are skipped.

get.summary: Match one segment against a partner's and TWB-wide memories

schema.title: Response Lookup Tm V1 Tms Lookup Get
Response List Termbases V1 Termbases Get

post.description: TBX v2/v3, or CSV with a header row of language codes (plus optional definition, domain, note); `a|b` gives several terms, `!term` marks one forbidden.

post.summary: Add one concept with its terms

parameters.name: pending

schema.description: Only reviewer proposals waiting for approval (FR4.7)
schema.title: Pending

parameters.description: Only reviewer proposals waiting for approval (FR4.7)

schema.title: Response List Concepts V1 Termbases  Termbase Id  Concepts Get

post.description: Approves every pending term of the given concepts (FR4.7); returns the count.

schema.title: Response Approve Concepts V1 Termbases  Termbase Id  Approve Post

get.summary: Term hits in a text, from a partner's and TWB-wide termbases

schema.title: Response Term Hits V1 Termbases Hits Get

get.summary: Effort and acceptance by language pair, engine, partner, reviewer or content type
get.description: Counts each segment a person decided in the period once, by its latest decision. group_by takes one or more of lang_pair, engine, partner, reviewer, content_type, match_band. Per-reviewer figures are for staff (FR6.5): this needs the reports scope. A non-admin key sees only its own jobs, or, for a reports key made for an integrating system, that system's jobs.

One ZIP with every job, segment, version, time entry, flag, memory (TMX), termbase (TBX), uploaded file and the engine and routing set-up, in open formats; README.md inside lists the files. Needs the admin scope. For large installations run `python -m app.export OUT.zip` on the server instead.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: When this step is due; with a time zone. Shown in the editor.

task_kind.title: Task Kind
task_kind.description: review, sme_review, translate: where it was written

adaptive.title: Adaptive
adaptive.description: Send glossary terms and memory examples.

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain-text source; segmented by the service.

external_ref.title: External Ref
external_ref.description: TWB task id; creation is idempotent on it.

review_langs.title: Review Langs
review_langs.description: Target languages that get a review task. Omit to review every target language; pass [] to deliver MT only (FR1.2).

sme_langs.title: Sme Langs
sme_langs.description: Target languages that get a partner subject-expert review after review (FR5.11). It opens once review of that language is complete.

sme_mode.title: Sme Mode
sme_mode.description: SME reviewers comment only, or may edit too.

due_at.title: Due At
due_at.description: When the partner needs the finished translation. Set a deadline per task on assign (review before expert review); a task without one shows this date to its reviewer.

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: The partner's brief for reviewers: audience, register, purpose (FR5.6).

reference_file_ids.title: Reference File Ids
reference_file_ids.description: Files uploaded with POST /v1/files?purpose=reference, shown to reviewers.

target_langs.title: Target Langs
target_langs.description: Languages to review again; omit for every reviewed language.

start.title: Start
start.description: The MT or memory text review started from

ui_lang.title: Ui Lang
ui_lang.description: Interface language for the editor (en, fr, es, ar, sw, pt); the reviewer can change it in the editor. Omit to use their browser's language.

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: Number of parts, each assigned separately.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: SME review only: comments only, or edits too (FR5.11)

total.title: Total
total.description: Source words in the task's segments

by_band.title: By Band
by_band.description: Source words by starting point: tm_101 and tm_100 (exact memory matches), fuzzy_95_99, fuzzy_85_94, fuzzy_75_84 (best memory match found), mt (machine translation with no useful match) and new (neither). For per-word payment models; no rates are applied here.

HTTPBearer.description: API key of the integrating system
